<%_ { _%>
<%_ const _U = getvar('stat_data.$ui') || {}, _OFF = _U.off || []; const on = id => typeof (_U.on || {})[id] === 'boolean' ? _U.on[id] : (id === 'happenings' ? _U.happenings !== 'off' : id === 'weather' ? (_U.wxfx || 'full') !== 'off' : id === 'ambience' ? (_U.ambience || 'full') !== 'off' : id === 'wxfull' ? (_U.wxfx || 'full') === 'full' : !_OFF.includes(id)); _%>
<%_ const _CARDS = {"letters":{"feature":"letters","text":"Letters (Mail Tower: birds carry them, numbered lockers hold them until collected): when {{user}} sends one, write {"From": "{{user}}", "To": "<who>", "Gist": "max 30 words", "Status": "sent"}; a letter written elsewhere waits until {{user}} is next at the Mail Tower, and the engine posts it then. The engine delivers every reply to {{user}}'s letters, family letters, and letters from people {{user}} has a bond with, and decides whether one comes at all: never add those yourself. A letter the story itself needs from anyone else (an office, a stranger, a campus event) you may add as {"<short title>": {"From": "", "To": "{{user}}", "Gist": "max 30 words", "Status": "waiting"}}. Set "read" when {{user}} collects and reads a letter (write the letter in the story, in the sender's own voice; a family letter uses what the player has written about home), "replied" once answered. A parcel from home is handed over by the engine."},"projects":{"feature":"projects","text":"Projects: {"<name>": {"Kind": "potion|smithing|tailoring|enchantment|cooking|painting|carving|calligraphy|craft|research|assignment|fair|club|other", "Goal": "", "Progress": 0-100, "Needs": "what is still missing", "Where": "where the work is done", "Due": "", "With": ""}}. Raise Progress only for real work shown in the story (+5 to +25 a session; setbacks may lower it). Remove it once handed in, used or abandoned. An assignment (Kind "assignment", With the classmates working on it) handed in: set Progress 100 first, then remove it next reply; the engine counts it as study time, or as a skipped class when late, and an overdue group assignment costs each partner Tension (who let the group down is the story's to play, in character). A Magical & Science Fair stand (Kind "fair", With the partners, Due "M7 W2 Sat") is built through Fair week; the staff panel scores it at the close of judging, and the engine sets the mark (the partners share it): remove it after that. A study session in /Practice with partners counts as a study interaction with each one present. A finished craft Project (potion to craft in Kind) is judged as a masterwork at Craft Rank 4: the engine puts the piece in the Bag and closes the Project."},"competition":{"feature":"competition","text":"Competition: {"Tier": "Dorm|Academy|Kingdom|World", "Status": "entered|qualified|eliminated|champion|selected", "Placement": "e.g. 7th of 40", "Team": ["teammates' first names"], "Results": ["R1: beat X"], "Rooms": ["Gareth: Room 3"]}. Update as rounds are fought. At the Dorm tier {{user}} fights in their role's bracket; the engine draws the bracket, names the next opponent in <now>, and sets Placement and Status from the Results lines. Write one Results line per bout in the form <now> gives. Most entrants are not roster characters: the crowd, the other bouts and any opponent <now> gives only as a label are yours to invent, as students of that dorm and year. At the Academy tier the engine forms the cross-dorm teams from the Dorm qualifiers and runs the knockout: {{user}}'s team is {{user}} and Team (replace a label with the name you give that student), and you report each match as "R<n>: beat <team>" or "R<n>: lost to <team>" in the form <now> gives; the engine sets Placement and Status, and the winning team goes on to the Kingdom Competition. At the Kingdom tier the engine runs the three rounds and the other three teams: report Halvard's part in the "Kingdom R<n>:" Results lines <now> gives, keep Rooms as where {{user}}'s teammates are during round two, and the engine sets Placement and Status (and, after the week, the World panel's pick). A bracket champion earns 100 points and the runner-up 50, and winning the Kingdom Competition pays 5,000 points each; the engine pays {{user}}. The engine also adds the result's reputation (qualifying from the Dorm tier, an Academy or Kingdom title) and bond XP for the Team once a tier: never report those in Rep_events or Interactions. After a title the staff expect {{user}} to defend it: teachers and coaches hold {{user}} to it, and the next early elimination costs Academy reputation (the engine charges it)."},"exams":{"feature":"study","text":"- Exams: the engine marks each subject (A top of the year, B above average, C passed, D weak pass, F failed) and posts the marks; in exam week <now> gives the expected marks: play each exam to its mark. A deciding moment (Fortune, the Expedition for Creature Studies) may move one subject one step: insert {"Subject": "<subject>", "Shift": 1 or -1, "Why": "max 8 words"} into /Exam_events/- ("Fail": true instead of Shift only for cheating caught, walking out or skipping the exam). The Fair mark stands in for the Month 9 Magic Theory midterm when it is better (the engine applies it). Never write Player.Academics; teachers and classmates know its Grades (the latest marks)."},"tutoring":{"feature":"study","text":"- Tutoring: with an A in a subject {{user}} can tutor it for pay; for each session played insert {"Subject": "<subject>", "Student": "name"} into /Tutoring/- (the engine pays and counts it; add no Points or Rep_events for it)."},"trip":{"feature":"trip","text":"Trip: when {{user}} departs on a trip (including the Kingdom Competition stay in the capital, if {{user}} is on Halvard's team) set {"Active": true, "Destination": "", "Companions": ["the group of four"], "Note": ""}; set Active false on return. The engine already treats the outside maps (the airship, the forest, Avalon, Sunreach Bay) as away, and ends a Trip left Active once {{user}} is back at a campus place."},"pacts":{"feature":"","text":"- Pacts (set by the Student Builder; key = the partner's name, Kind = Spirit, Demon, Monster, Animal or Human): when {{user}} summons a pact partner, set /Magic/Pacts/<name>/Summoned true AND add /Magic/Active/<name> = {"Technique": "Summon <name>"}. The partner can use only its own abilities, each a technique "<name>: <ability>" in _Techniques (a Casts entry, or Active if lasting); an older pact with none listed pays each ability as a Casts entry for "Summon <name>". On dismissal set Summoned false and remove the Active entry (the engine keeps the two in step when one is missing). Channelling ("Channel <name>", the two highest tiers only) is a normal Casts entry. Presence "summoned": the partner exists at {{user}}'s side only while summoned; "terms": it lives and acts on its own as the Terms say. Any Kind but Spirit is the forbidden art of Pacting."},"first_pact":{"feature":"","text":"- A first pact in play: a student with Occult magic may form a Spirit Pact with one lesser spirit at the Spirit Path, only when the scene has played it out (the spirit chose them). Add /Magic/Pacts/<name> with Kind "Spirit", Tier "Lesser", Presence "summoned" and Terms naming what it can do (a lesser spirit is small and simple: it helps, fetches, keeps watch, comforts; it does not fight well); the engine writes its Summon technique. One such pact in play, ever; the engine removes any other."},"interactions":{"feature":"","text":"Interactions: for each real interaction in this reply insert into /Interactions/- {"With": "<roster first name>", "Kind": "talk|hangout|study|gift|help|fight|apology|keep|secret|defend|confide|understood|letdown|offence|birthday|birthday_party"}. Add "Note": one short sentence of what happened between them, in the past tense (shared history). When no listed kind fits, use {"With": "<first name>", "Kind": "other", "Note": "..."}. talk is a real conversation; hangout is time spent together; study is active shared learning and uses the hangout daily slot. At Rank 2+, add "Invited": true to the first accepted hangout you actually proposed that week. gift also needs Item and Gift (loved|liked|neutral|disliked|hated), though the engine resolves NPC tastes first. help is real help; fight includes a spar; apology may have Public:true; keep, secret, defend and confide describe actual deeds; understood is a real repaired misunderstanding; letdown and offence take a Weight (Trust and Tension); birthday means a greeting or gift; birthday_party requires actual attendance. Passing greetings add nothing. talk, hangout, study, help and gift count only with the NPC in the scene; a letter or a message from afar is Kind "other". Report shared acts once."},"trust_tension":{"feature":"","text":"- Trust 0–100: how sure they are that {{user}} can be relied on (closeness is Rank). It rises from deeds reported as interactions (keep, secret, defend, confide, help); the engine adds them slowly, by the character's nature, and a little for each rank earned. A letdown is reported, never written as a number: {"With": "<first name>", "Kind": "letdown", "Weight": "…"}. small: late for or forgetting something small that was promised, or a quarrel between friends; broken: a real promise broken, or a lie found out; secret_told: their secret told, or something they said in private used against them; betrayal: reporting them, siding with their enemy, selling them out. Each counts and several add up; word of a big one reaches their friends. Low Trust holds back what the bond would give (keeping {{user}}'s secrets from Rank 6, real risks from Rank 7, a best friendship or romance at Rank 8, Rank 9–10); each present character's Cast Sheet ("Now with {{user}}") says what is held back and how they carry it.
- Tension 0–100: conflict and unresolved friction. Report each offence in the same reply: {"With": "<first name>", "Kind": "offence", "Weight": "…"}. slight: a slight or a sharp word; jealous: flirting with someone else in front of a romantic partner; insult: an insult, a humiliation or a broken promise (a broken promise is also a letdown); violence: a punch or a spell against them. Several add up and are never capped: one bad day can make an enemy. Never lower Tension for an apology: report the apology and the engine applies what their nature allows (some forgive easily, some hold grudges, some take it as weakness). Quiet days ease it too; only a great deed (saving them, a real sacrifice) may lower it directly. Mending is slower than harm. How each character carries tension, and what eases it, is in their Cast Sheet. The engine counts the rest: from 40 bond XP is halved, from 70 rank growth pauses and reputation suffers, from 90 no bond XP, at 100 the bond loses a rank.
- Judging a deed: by what the character believes {{user}} meant, not by the harm alone. Add "Meant": "no_harm" to a letdown for carelessness or good intent (a real try that fails, a secret that slips out, a lie to protect them or for a surprise once understood, letting them down over a clash of promises after warning them); the engine takes much less. "Meant": "forced" when they know {{user}} had no choice (forced, charmed, protecting them): no Trust is lost. Carelessness is an offence only if it truly cost them something. Teasing, mock insults and play-fighting that both sides enjoy are not offences: report them as talk or hangout; whether a character enjoys them is theirs (their Cast Sheet, "Teasing", and how the story shows them taking it). Harsh words from someone they trust (Trust 65+) who plainly means well are not offences either. A consensual spar is a fight, not violence, unless {{user}} fought dirty or kept going after they yielded. Only count what the character saw or later learns of."},"reputation":{"feature":"","text":"Reputation deeds, each reported in /Rep_events/- as {"Kind": "deed_name", "Why": "max 8 words"}:
  - Academy kinds: staff_job, crisis_help / crisis_help_major; caught_after_curfew, detention / detention_tower, lied_to_staff, defied_staff, property_damage / serious_property_damage, fight_outside_ward / serious_fight_outside_ward, public_scandal.
  - Student kinds: student_notice_help, club_office, club_festival_win, memorable_performance, community_event, defended_student / defended_student_from_doves, famous_prank, covered_classmate; dropped_student_request, public_snub, reported_student_to_staff, quit_club_midseason, bullying / severe_bullying, reported_student_to_doves, caught_cheating.
  - Doves kinds: cooperated_with_dove, attentive_in_dmd, helped_dove_case / major_dove_case, reported_forbidden_magic; suspicious_item, insulted_dove, defied_doves_publicly, restricted_area, lied_to_doves, obstructed_search. If a public defense angered the Doves, also report defied_doves_publicly; if a prank or cover-up was caught, also report caught_pranking or caught_covering_classmate (the second side of a report to staff or the Doves is the engine's)."},"extras":{"feature":"","text":"Extras: when <now> asks (their second appearance), add their record: {"<Full Name>": {"Who": "role, age, race", "Looks": "what anyone would notice about them on an ordinary day", "Manner": "how they act and talk", "Calls_user": "what they call {{user}}", "Voice": "one typical line"}}. <cast> then shows it whenever they are present."},"doves":{"feature":"","text":"- Dove secrets (<now> lists them): what the Dovecote would act on if it knew. When {{user}} does something the Doves would arrest or question them for (uses or helps a forbidden art, enters a place the Doves forbid, keeps a forbidden item, lies to a Dove and is believed) and no Dove learns of it, add /Hidden/Secrets/<short name> = {"What": "max 20 words", "Proof": "what could give it away", "Known_by": ["who else knows"]}. A secret the Doves catch at once is not a secret: report the deed instead. Update Proof when it is destroyed or moved; remove the secret when the story makes it moot.
- Dove_attention 0–100: report a rise of +3 to +10 when a secret could realistically be noticed, +15 to +25 when it is witnessed or detected (a Dark Magic Defense drill, a Dove close by, a search, Vesna surviving what should kill her). The engine owns every fall, and the interview, the search and the hearing in <now>: play their results as given.
- When the Doves learn a secret in the story, insert {"Secret": "<its name in <now>>", "How": "max 12 words"} into /Dove_found/-; the engine records it (Koschei's Needle goes to the Dovecote). Then report the deeds the moment earned."},"imprints":{"feature":"","text":"- Imprints: only after an experience with {{user}} that changes who they are (weight 5–10 of 10: a rescue, a great betrayal, a sacrifice), insert {"Belief": "what they now believe, in their words", "Weight": 5-10, "From": "what caused it", "Feel": "warm | sore | bittersweet" (how remembering it feels)}. Write the belief, not the event ("Rules can bend for someone who has earned it"). At most 5. Follow their change type (below): a fixed character only deepens a belief they hold (raise its Weight). The engine keeps the rest."},"old_hut":{"feature":"","text":"- The Old Hut custom (what is said inside stays there): a confidence shared there, reported as confide or secret as usual, counts a little more; the engine adds it, once a month for each person. Report it only when it truly happened, true to the character."},"training":{"feature":"","text":"- Training: when {{user}} spends a real session (about an hour or more) drilling to grow their mana pool or stamina, insert {"Track":"mana|stamina","With":"<first name>"} into /Practice/-. Omit With for solo sessions. The engine raises Mana_max / Stamina_max within existing limits. A Rank 4+ NPC actively helping with a track listed in their Cast Sheet (mana, stamina or study) adds a small bonus; a personal training gift may add more. Being in the room alone is not participation."},"practice":{"feature":"proficiency","text":"- Practice: when {{user}} spends real time practising or crafting at a place (Practice here in <now>), report {"Action":"<listed action>","Subject":"<subject, for study>","With":"<person, if any>","Aim":"<intention or item>"} in /Practice/-. Report the attempt once, whatever the result. The engine checks place, time, company, requirements and the weekly limit, then clears the report. A listed action that trains mana or stamina counts as that training session; do not report the training separately."},"dorm":{"feature":"","text":"- Dorm is set once, by the Arbiter Stone sorting. The Stone reads only Magic._Affinity.Dominant (Elemental→Fire, Mystic→Light, Spiritual→Viridian, Occult→Sky); it cannot see subtypes, or whether magic is hidden or forbidden."},"combat_role":{"feature":"","text":"- Combat_role: empty until {{user}}'s first Practical Magic class (Month 1 Week 1 Thursday, a joint assessment). There the five role teachers watch {{user}} in drills and assign one or two roles (Attack, Defense, Healing, Support, Control) that fit the techniques and how {{user}} actually fought; set it then (e.g. "Defense, Control"). With two roles, {{user}} picks the one class they want most; write that role first. Change it later only when a teacher reassigns it or {{user}} switches class."},"favour":{"feature":"planner","text":"- A favour (Type "favour", With one character) is a promise to that character. Remove it when {{user}} has done it (an Item must be in the Bag; the engine hands it over and counts the favour as help, so do not report it again). Left overdue, it costs Tension; the character reacts in character."},"notices":{"feature":"notices","text":"Notices (the Notice Board, castle Floor 1 entrance hall): {"<title>": {"Text": "max 25 words", "By": "who posted it", "Until": "M? W? Day"}}. Only notices {{user}} has seen that matter: paid work, club recruitment, a warning, a dare, a lost item. Official calendar postings are shown automatically; never add them. The engine dates and expires notices."},"vigil":{"feature":"weather","text":"The Vigil: it holds off sleep debt for 48 hours, then {{user}} crashes until two full nights are slept; buying or gifting it does not activate it."},"exposure":{"feature":"","text":"Exposure: when a hit or accident soaks {{user}} through (a water spell, a dunking in the lake, a bucket of water) insert {"Kind":"soaked","Cause":"<what>"} into /Exposure/- in that same reply; for a freezing hit (an ice or frost spell) use "chilled". The engine sets the condition at once and adds the cold that follows (outdoors at freezing a soaking also chills). A splash that does not soak through is not reported."},"fold":{"feature":"","text":"Fold (memory; this reply only, besides the usual update): the game keeps older memory by folding several old records into one. Write {"op": "replace", "path": "/Fold", "value": "<the fold>"}: one plain entry, within the words given below, that keeps who did what, why and what changed; keep every name, promise, debt, death and secret the lines hold; add nothing they do not say, and no date (the game adds it). Fold exactly these lines:"},"founding":{"feature":"","text":"Founding a club (Campus_State.Founded_club {"Name": "", "Venue": "a campus place", "Advisor": "", "Members": ["students other than {{user}}"]}): founding takes a teaching staff signature and five members, {{user}} included; the Student Council assigns a room from whatever is left. Every teacher on record already answers for one club and signs for no second: the advisor is a teacher of your own making (one of Halvard's many teachers not yet named), introduced like any new character. A student joins only on screen and only if they would; one who joins leaves their old club (the Student Council is kept). Etnie and Topaz follow {{user}} into any club. Once the signature, five members and the room are in place the engine marks the club founded and makes {{user}} its member; it sets Status, pays the reputation (never report founded_club) and records each member's move."}}, _R = (_U.now || {}).rules; const _show = Object.keys(_CARDS).filter(id => (Array.isArray(_R) ? _R.includes(id) : true) && (!_CARDS[id].feature || on(_CARDS[id].feature))); _%>
<%_ if (_show.length) { _%>
<rule_cards>
The update rules for what is going on now (they complete the core lines of <variable_update_rules>):
<%_ for (const id of _show) { _%>
<%- _CARDS[id].text %>
<%_ if (id === 'imprints') { const _CH = {"type":{"Etnie":"fixed","Irene":"fixed","Aiden":"shaped","Castor":"shaped","Zara":"shaped","Kanae":"shaped","Rei":"fixed","Caine":"shaped","Caralynn":"shaped","Percival":"fixed","Trixie":"fluid","Vera":"fixed","Alyssa":"fixed","Lenna":"shaped","Saffi":"fixed","Idris":"shaped","Dante":"fixed","Florian":"fluid","Tilly":"fixed","Caspian":"fixed","Royhan":"shaped","Sophia":"fixed","Gareth":"fixed","Ruby":"fixed","Gavlan":"fixed","Yvette":"fixed","Baelin":"fixed","Layla":"fixed","Vallie":"fixed","Kuroo":"fixed","Mimosa":"shaped","Althair":"fixed","Ezrel":"fixed","Ottavio":"fixed","Krieg":"fixed","Milena":"shaped","Tristan":"fixed","Bobby":"shaped","Linus":"shaped","Maple":"shaped","Nerys":"fixed","Hadrian":"fixed","Wren":"shaped","Tsubaki":"shaped","Hester":"fixed","Anselm":"fixed","Magnus":"fixed","Dorian":"fixed","Cedric":"fixed","Anya":"fixed","Kotaro":"fixed","Valentin":"fixed","Aurelian":"fixed","William":"shaped","Bruno":"shaped","Bianca":"shaped","Rigel":"shaped","Topaz":"shaped","Faye":"shaped","Vesna":"shaped"},"def":{"fixed":"Experience deepens who they are; it never rewrites them.","shaped":"A major, repeated experience can change one part of them for good; the old self still shows under stress.","fluid":"They change with their surroundings over months (a new year, a new circle), never within one scene."}}, _CS = _U.cast || {}, _HERE = [...(_CS.full || []), ...(_CS.brief || [])].filter(n => _CH.type[n]); _%>
<%_ if (_HERE.length) { _%>
  Change type of those here: <%- _HERE.map(n => n + ' ' + _CH.type[n]).join(', ') %> (<%- [...new Set(_HERE.map(n => _CH.type[n]))].map(t => t + ': ' + _CH.def[t]).join(' ') %>)
<%_ } } _%>
<%_ if (id === 'fold' && _U.fold && Array.isArray(_U.fold.lines)) { _%>
  Fold <%- _U.fold.label %>, at most <%- _U.fold.max %> words:
<%_ for (const _l of _U.fold.lines) { _%>
  - <%- _l %>
<%_ } } _%>
<%_ if (id === 'reputation') { _%>
<%_ if (on('study')) { _%>
  Paid tutoring is /Tutoring, not student_notice_help.
<%_ } else { _%>
  With Study off: the Academy kinds also include fair_prize; report exam top of the year +15, above average +8, passed +3, dorm rank up on Results day +5, failed exam −8 and several −15 (Academy), and a top Dark Magic Defense exam +8 (Doves), through legacy Rep_events.
<%_ } if (!on('attendance')) { _%>
  With Attendance off, the Student kinds also include club_time.
<%_ } } _%>
<%_ } _%>
</rule_cards>
<%_ } _%>
<%_ } _%>

Students may buy alcohol and tobacco and receive them as gifts, but may drink or smoke only on the rest day (Sunday), during Mid-Year Break (M5 W4), and in Month 12. Festival nights do not count, and academy feasts serve students no alcohol. Staff enforce it like curfew: a student caught drinking or smoking on a class day loses points and gets a mark on their record. Barrow & Vine asks for the bracelet and says so at the counter.
